title: When AI Improves Answers but Slows Knowledge Creation: Matching and Dynamic Knowledge Creation in Digital Public Goods
abstract: arXiv:2604.00468v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative AI helps users solve problems more efficiently, but can also replace exchanges between people with private conversations with chatbots. When more problems are solved privately, fewer problem-solving episodes are converted into reusable public knowledge for others. We build a dynamic model of public good provision where agents post and answer questions on a public platform. AI can shrink the platform's archive through two margins. Private diversion can reduce the posted volume of knowledge-enhancing questions (the flow margin), while contributor exit can lower conditional resolution (the resolution margin). Low-archive traps can arise with or without AI, because a thin archive makes public answering too costly to sustain; AI can narrow the viable region. The model gives conditional empirical predictions that distinguish demand-side diversion from supply-side pool thinning under explicit identifying restrictions. Logging pri

translated_title: 当AI提升答案质量却减缓知识创造：数字公共品中的匹配与动态知识创造
translated_abstract: 生成式AI帮助用户更高效地解决问题，但也可能用与聊天机器人的私密对话取代人与人之间的交流。当更多问题被私下解决时，更少的问题解决过程被转化为可供他人重复使用的公共知识。我们构建了一个公共品供给的动态模型，其中参与者在公共平台上发布和回答问题。AI可以通过两个边际渠道缩减平台的档案库：私人转移可能减少知识增强型问题的发布数量（流量边际），而贡献者退出可能降低条件解决率（解决率边际）。低档案陷阱无论有无AI都可能出现，因为稀薄的档案库使得公共回答的成本过高而难以维持；而AI可能进一步缩小可行区域。该模型在明确的识别限制下给出了区分需求侧转移与供给侧池变薄的条件性实证预测。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个公共品供给的动态模型，揭示生成式AI虽然提升了问题解决效率，但会通过“私人转移”和“贡献者退出”两个渠道缩减公共知识库，从而引发低档案陷阱并减缓公共知识的创造。
en_tdlr: This paper builds a dynamic model of public goods provision showing that generative AI, despite improving problem-solving efficiency, can shrink public knowledge archives through private diversion and contributor exit, potentially triggering low-archive traps and slowing collective knowledge creation.
